# Stroller Review Content And Data Rules

## Review Content Structure

- Every review must include: age range, weight range, folded size, suspension, material, certifications, and price range.
- Use fixed conclusion sections: `target_users`, `key_strengths`, `key_weaknesses`, `buying_advice`.
- Use objective wording and avoid absolute claims (such as "best" or "only").

## Data Credibility

- New entries must include `source_url` or `source_note`.
- Preserve multiple versions for conflicting data; do not overwrite directly.
- Price fields must include currency and capture date.

## SEO And Multilingual Quality

- Keep title length between 50-65 characters (EN) or 24-32 characters (ZH).
- Summaries should contain model keywords and core usage scenario terms.
- Chinese and English content must be semantically aligned; avoid raw machine translation output.
